images.title: What are reasoning models?
images.subtitle: AI models that write out their working before they answer, and what that costs.

images.title: A reasoning model works like a nurse writing out a dose

pairs.left: Glances at an easy case and answers
pairs.right: A regular chatbot replies straight away

pairs.left: Writes the calculation line by line on paper
pairs.right: Writes a chain of steps before replying

pairs.left: Rechecks each line before giving the dose
pairs.right: Checks and corrects steps along the way

pairs.left: Takes longer, so saves it for high stakes
pairs.right: Uses more time and tokens, so use it when needed

images.note: Unlike the nurse, the model can still write a wrong line with full confidence.

images.title: The same question, answered two ways

columns.heading: Regular reply
items: Can miss a slip in a multi-step problem

columns.heading: With reasoning
items: Steps are written first, then the answer
Many extra tokens, billed as output

images.verdict: Pay for the extra thinking only when the question is hard enough to need it.

images.title: Rewards for right answers teach the model to work things out

items.label: Pick checkable problems
items.text: Math and code, where a final answer can be marked right or wrong.

items.label: Model writes its steps
items.text: It tries a chain of steps, then gives a final answer.

items.label: Answer is checked
items.text: A program marks the final answer correct or not.

items.label: Reward, then repeat
items.text: Step patterns that led to right answers become more likely.

images.note: This is reinforcement learning, repeated over a very large number of problems.

images.title: Switch reasoning on for hard problems, skip it for easy ones

items.label: Use: multi-step math
items.text: Word problems with several linked steps.

items.label: Use: code
items.text: Tricky bugs and logic that must hold together.

items.label: Skip: simple lookups
items.text: Facts and definitions need no long chain.

items.label: Skip: short rewrites
items.text: Fixing a sentence or an email is quick.

items.label: Skip: casual chat
items.text: Extra waiting adds nothing to small talk.

images.note: Even a hard problem still needs checking: reasoning does not remove errors.
